response_item.revised_prompt: Create ONE new review-only GAME SPRITE source asset, using the attached ORIGINAL approved street-corner concept (grey stone single-storey corner building, hooded person, municipal camera, grey pavement) as the visual reference. Do NOT use the second attached gameplay screenshot's turquoise/red-brick two-storey building as design inspiration. Deliver a complete isolated building, transparent RGBA background, square 1024x1024 canvas. Reconstruct the reference's same low, SINGLE-STOREY weathered warm-grey stone corner architecture: charcoal recessed tall windows, restrained cream-grey pilasters and cornice, a chamfered front corner with ONE dark brown entry door and tiny amber lamp, shallow flat dark-grey roof with one muted ventilation unit and short pipe. Thin dark hand-painted edge accents, subdued neutral palette, chipped stone, broad coherent wear shapes rather than noise. Soft light from upper left. No turquoise, no exposed orange brick, no second floor, no decorative roof balls, no separate street props, no person, no camera, no floor tiles, no pavement slab, no external ground, no baked cast shadow, no lettering, no annotations, no grid, no watermark. Subject must fit completely with transparent margins. Technical geometry: elevated orthographic source view, vertical wall edges remain vertical, ground/roof square sides run at screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5 (midpoint 2:1 projected ground). Intended ground footprint is a diamond with virtual corners BACK (512,450), LEFT (112,650), FRONT (512,850), RIGHT (912,650), in x-right/y-down canvas pixels. Front corner is chamfered, its entry face endpoints lie approximately (452,820) and (572,820), the virtual front (512,850) is a registration guide only and must NOT be drawn. Walls rise approximately 380 pixels vertically. Keep the source's one-storey facade low relative to footprint, NOT the tall two-storey runtime building. The footprint coordinates are layout targets that will be independently inspected, not a request to draw markers. Make a strong coherent source asset that resembles the approved reference's stone architecture and material treatment, not a pasted screenshot crop.
